executive_summary: OpenClaw currently has a bounded Mission Control request-file service. It classifies approved request files, routes them through deterministic local rails, writes heartbeat/response readbacks, and uses read models/SQLite receipts for selected rails. The LM and worker stages are mostly contract-only, LM-shaped selection, package staging, no-op worker receipts, and review packet lifecycle, not live model or worker execution.
current_chain_versus_desired_chain: The current runtime is not a single linear universal chain; it is a request-family router with separate deterministic rails.
The privacy gate exists as hash-only package-queue privacy rows, not a universal dynamic PII gate before every rail.
LM1 is not live; it is contract-only/deterministic selection over existing action payloads.
The package compiler exists for the workflow-package rail, not every request family.
SQLite package truth exists, but only selected rails have SQLite-backed canonical rows.
Capability/provider gate exists as dry-run gate rows and registry read models, not a live provider executor.
LM2/worker cage is not live; it is child-package gate contracts, package stubs, and review lifecycle.
Worker receipts are no-op/offline/rail-specific, not live worker cage receipts.
Business-action gates are closed by default; no live executor was found.
Dynamic cards are partial and fragmented; a generic card packet is still needed.

stage_coverage_table.authority_boundary: Service authority flags deny broad watch, live workflow execution, model/tool/agent dispatch, email, Coupa, browser, raw body ingestion, Mac sync import, network, and git push/pull/fetch.
Context identifies the lane only; it does not grant lane, file, workbook, send, ledger, merge, push, or worker authority.
Privacy gate does not authorize provider calls, raw prompt storage, raw workbook reads, or external sharing.
No model invocation, provider connection, worker spawn, business action, or authority creation.
Compiled package authority_boundary defaults all protected actions false.
Registry rows are proof/status only; registry writes do not execute actions or grant authority.
Provider choice does not grant authority; external LLM, Coupa/browser, local model runtime, and Codex automation remain blocked unless a separate future gate exists.
Gate/approval rows record state; business action authority must still pass a separate executor/gate that is not present in this chain.
Worker does not inherit speaker authority. Child spawning, worker execution, tool calls, external LLMs, push, and business actions remain false.
A receipt is proof of local processing/output, not authority to mutate business systems.
Review packet index cannot merge, push, spawn, or grant business authority.
Review decisions do not merge, push, spawn workers, send, submit, mutate ledgers/workbooks, or grant business authority.
Email, Gmail, browser, Coupa, portal submit, ledger, workbook mutation/open/body read, PDF export, paid/sent, merge, push, worker spawn, and external action stay closed.
Cards and answers can render or stage safe payloads only; they cannot execute external actions or grant authority.
Memory candidates do not mutate business truth, promote paid/sent state, expose raw prompts, or bypass approval.

what_exists_and_is_good: Approved-inbox bounded request pickup and duplicate skipping.
Fail-closed router behavior when authority_boundary contains true grants.
Contextual system-question short-circuit that prevents diagnostic package staging.
Workflow package queue storing raw text as protected hashes rather than raw prompt bodies.
Capability and business-action gates defaulting to closed.
Operator review packet language that separates worker output from speaker authority.
Provider selection registry stating provider choice does not grant authority.
what_is_partial: Workflow Composer is planning only and safe_to_execute=false.
Harness provider selection is registry only.
Spawned worker package lifecycle is read-model contract only.
Worker package staging creates local package stubs only.
OpenClaw LM child package gate models child package policy but does not spawn swarms.
Operator card render packet contract is non-executing.
Business-action gate rows are closed and not an executor.
what_is_missing: A universal runtime envelope that makes context, privacy, proof refs, and dynamic card output consistent across all request families.
A live LM1 planner; current state is intentionally contract-only/deterministic substitute.
A real LM2 worker cage runtime with sandbox, authority checks, receipts, and review.
A single generic dynamic card packet emitted by the backend for every operator-visible response.
A dedicated universal receipt envelope for package, worker, review, approval, and business-action outcomes.
A positive business-action executor gate; current gates are closed and protective.
A universal approval-to-execution bridge; current approval records do not execute actions.
what_should_not_be_built_yet: A real LM2 worker cage runtime

current_guards: workflow_package_queue stores protected_text_hash and raw_text_stored=0 for package inputs
lm_bounded_operator_orchestration requires selected action to exist in operator_action_payloads
system_question_answer answers from local read models and SQLite metadata only
evidence_confidence_scoring ranks receipts/hashes/source rows above generated summaries
memory_promotion_gate keeps candidate memory separate from truth promotion
guardian_output_gate validates response payloads before publication
remaining_risks: Ad hoc response/card fields may make generated summaries look like app truth if not paired with explicit proof refs.
Approval records can be mistaken for execution proof unless card copy separates approval, execution, and receipt.
LM-shaped recommendation copy can sound authoritative unless safe_to_execute and provider_choice_grants_authority stay visible.
false_recursive_truth_risks.rule: LM output is never truth by itself.

minimum_viable_runtime_upgrade_path: Freeze existing request-response, workflow-package, system-question, workroom-review, and workbook-registration behavior with focused regression tests.
Add backend dynamic_card_packet as an additive field beside existing visible_cards/operator_display fields.
Populate dynamic_card_packet for system-question, workflow-package, workroom-review, and workbook-registration rails first.
Add bridge equality and Mac-render smoke tests that compare old card content to new card packets.
Only after dynamic cards are stable, define a universal receipt envelope shared by package, approval, review, and future worker rails.
Keep live LM/worker/business-action activation blocked until privacy, authority, sandbox, receipt, review, and rollback gates are test-backed.
recommended_next_three_backend_tasks: Freeze existing request-response, workflow-package, system-question, workroom-review, and workbook-registration behavior with focused regression tests.
Add backend dynamic_card_packet as an additive field beside existing visible_cards/operator_display fields.
Populate dynamic_card_packet for system-question, workflow-package, workroom-review, and workbook-registration rails first.
